The locomotive that first carried passengers over a public railway – **_Locomotion No. 1** – was built by **Robert Stephenson & Co.**.  
Robert Stephenson & Co. was founded in **1823** (in Newcastle upon Tyne) by George Stephenson, his son Robert Stephenson, and partners. This company was the world’s first locomotive‑manufacturing firm and supplied _Locomotion No. 1_ for the Stockton and Darlington Railway in 1825.  

**Answer:** **1823**.
